column1: Intel invents at the boundaries of technology to make amazing experiences possible for business and society, and for every
person on Earth. Our innovations are bringing sight, touch, depth perception, and the ability to communicate to devices,
objects, and spaces to make them smart and connected. We harness the capability of the cloud and the Internet of Things
to disrupt industries and solve global challenges—such as those in healthcare, agriculture, and commerce. We also lead in
environmental sustainability, supply chain responsibility, diversity and inclusion, and social impact.
This Report was prepared using the Global Reporting Initiative* (GRI) Sustainability Reporting Standards.
To view or download the full report, visit intel.com/responsibility.
